inputs.text: Vertical side-angle medium close shot of Lin Xiaoyu making a cautious first transfer. The phone screen faces only her and is completely hidden; camera sees the matte back and her natural five-finger grip. Her expression mixes doubt and trust. Premium handcrafted 3D plush doll, cool tense bedroom light, realistic hands, shallow depth of field, no visible UI, no text. Animate only the following controlled action. Start: Lin Xiaoyu holds exactly one phone vertically at chest height with its matte back facing camera and both hands already touching it. Action: the phone and both hands remain fixed in the same position; only her eyes lower toward the hidden screen and her right index fingertip bends by two millimeters. End: the phone remains fully visible at chest height with the matte back facing camera. Motion is extremely small. Preserve the exact first-frame composition, character identity, outfit, props, and room. The camera stays locked and stable. Only subtle lip and eye movement. The phone must never leave, rotate, flip, or expose its screen.
